Policy is a union-only whitelist extension (empty by default = observe-only); changes go through “Write policy draft” → confirmation dialog (checking ≠ installing); the 60s is only the hook process’s local cache TTL; on expiry it re-reads the same permanently cached RemotePreferences instance whose underlying mMap may still be stale.
